handoff_instructions.purpose: Handoffs document the current state and scope of the project so a new LLM session can pick up exactly where the last one left off. They are the primary continuity mechanism for this project.
what_to_include: A summary of what was done, discussed, built, or decided in this session
What worked and what did not work
Current pipeline state — what scripts exist, what their status is, what the next steps are
A condensed recap of prior sessions so the new LLM has full project context without reading every previous handoff
Open questions or blockers that carry into the next session
what_not_to_include: Exhaustive code listings — reference file paths instead
Decisions that were reversed or abandoned mid-session — only document final state
Speculation about distant future work — stay close to what is actually next
format_rules: This handoff_instructions block must appear at the top of every future handoff
When a user says 'create a handoff for this session,' use this block as the template and fill in the session-specific fields
Prior session summaries should be condensed — one paragraph per session, not a full retelling
Be brief but complete. A new LLM should be able to start working immediately after reading this file

this_session.summary: Analyzed T20–T25 post-improvement results (Nolan ran them between sessions). These used the post-9-improvement m3_infer.py but the pre-restructure KP — session 9.1 flagged them as stale, but the directional findings are valid. Pass rate improved from 0/6 to 2/6. Then discussed architecture for handling real-world context (client messages, estimator verbal notes). Decided on a job_context.txt sidecar file per job. Implemented changes to m3_infer.py: new --job flag with auto-PDF discovery via use_*.txt version markers, --knowledge-pack explicit arg, optional --out, and context injection into both Gemini and Claude prompts. Created the Mabrey Estates test job folder with a fully populated job_context.txt and use_newest.txt marker.

new_functions: resolve_job_version(job_path) — reads use_*.txt marker (use_newest→newest/, use_v1→legacy/1/, use_v2→legacy/2/) and returns the active version subfolder. Falls back to newest/ if no marker found.
find_job_input(job_path) — calls resolve_job_version(), then discovers plans/*.pdf or plan_images/*.jpg in the version folder.
read_job_context(job_path) — calls resolve_job_version(), reads job_context.txt from version folder if present.
modified_functions: gemini_extract() — added context: str | None = None param. When provided, prepends a '=== ESTIMATOR CONTEXT ===' framing block before the extraction prompt so Gemini gets scope hints (geometry constraints, measurement methods).

build_user_message() — added context: str | None = None param. Injects an '## Estimator Context' section at the top of the Claude user message, before extracted facts. Labelled as taking precedence over standard rules.
claude_infer() — added context: str | None = None param, threads to build_user_message().
resolve_holdout() — changed SystemExit to a print warning + return (None, None) when job is not in case library. Needed for new jobs like Mabrey that have no case library entry yet.
main() — added --job flag (replaces --input/--holdout pair), --knowledge-pack explicit flag, made --out optional (auto-derived as phase1/inference/output_<folder>/<folder_lower>.md).

context_contents.client_message: 5-acre parcel, using Painted Rock as comparison, 5% cost escalation factor for time. Buffer because parcel fronts public street on one end only, not a corner like Painted Rock.
estimator_directives: ANALOG: Painted Rock is forced PRIMARY analog — do not override with ROW_SF proximity search.
PRICE ESCALATION: Apply 1.05× multiplier to all Painted Rock-derived unit prices. Flag each with [+5% escalation from Painted Rock].
SCOPE QUALIFIER: One-end frontage only (not a corner) — fewer connection points than Painted Rock.

SEWER EXCLUDED: Do NOT estimate sewer connection or sewer main. Replace entire sewer section with 'SEWER: NOT ESTIMATED — requires field visit to verify depth and attachment feasibility (Brian to price separately).'
LF MEASUREMENT HINT (for Gemini): Count lot dimension lines around road perimeter + use curve data tables (delta angles, radii) for curved segments to cross-check stationing.

operational_constraints.never_run_python_scripts_directly: Tell the user the command and wait for them to paste output. Never execute python scripts.
operational_constraints.gemini_model_string: Do not change the GEMINI_MODEL string in any script. Nolan sets it and it stays as-is.
operational_constraints.version_alignment: PDF/DWG/qty-sheet/proposal per job may be different revisions. Nolan verifies manually — do not automate cross-document version matching.
operational_constraints.use_txt_files: use_*.txt files in job folder roots are the authoritative version selectors. resolve_job_version() reads them. Format: use_newest.txt → newest/, use_v1.txt → legacy/1/, use_v2.txt → legacy/2/.
